description: Source code for a React component implementing a modal dialog for selecting channels, including search, pagination, and multi-select functionality within the Mattermost project.

classes.name: ChannelSelectorModal
classes.description: React component class for a modal dialog that allows users to search, select, and add channels with support for pagination and filtering.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial load of channels when the component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to search term and triggers channel search or reload.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal and resets search term.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Callback for when modal exit animation completes.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, invokes callback with selected channels.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a channel to the selected values.

methods.name: handlePageChange
methods.description: Loads additional channels when page changes.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Handles search input and updates search term.

methods.name: renderOption
methods.description: Renders individual channel options in the list.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the modal component.
